_docs.pins: Reserve a key for a non-agent destination. A pinned slot is NEVER auto-assigned, so each pin reduces agent capacity by one. Shape: {"7": {"host": "pinned-app", "app": "ChatGPT", "label_top": "ask", "label_bottom": "ChatGPT"}}
_docs.journal.vault: Absolute path to an Obsidian vault. Reserved for the journal exporter; unused in v1.
_docs.renderers: Absolute paths to executables that receive the fleet snapshot on stdin. Each is bounded at 3s and may not break reconcile.
